info.name: Core accepted countries Credit Account Disputes API

params.name: account_token
params.description:
Unique identifier of the credit account for which to retrieve the disputes.

Send a `GET` request to `/credit/accounts` to retrieve existing credit account tokens.

params.name: count
params.description: Number of disputes resources to retrieve.

params.name: start_index
params.description: Sort order index of the first resource in the returned array.

params.name: sort_by
params.description:
Field on which to sort.
Prefix the field name with a hyphen (`-`) to sort in descending order.
Omit the hyphen to sort in ascending order.

*NOTE:*
You must sort using system field names such as `lastModifiedTime`, and not by the field names appearing in response bodies such as `last_modified_time`.

params.name: ledger_entry_tokens
params.description:
Unique identifier of the journal entry in dispute.
This type of identifier can only be used for `authorization.clearing`-type journal entries.

items.docs:
Retrieve an array of disputes on a credit account.
